name: Cut Your Losses
benefit:
Whenever you withdraw as
 a full-round action and have at least one
 free hand, you can pick up one unattended
 object or unconscious ally of your size or
 smaller at any point during your movement without
 provoking attacks of opportunity. Any additional
 movement performed on your turn still provokes attacks
 of opportunity as normal.

 In addition, you treat your Strength score as 2 higher
 for the purpose of determining your carrying capacity.
flavor:
You realize that sometimes it’s a safer
 bet to simply get out of danger’s way
 as fast as possible. You are able to
 summon a surge of adrenaline when
 you grab what is most dear to you
 and run.
